# benny-the-dog-mcp - LLM Reference

Benny the dog health and care monitor - water bowls, movement, loneliness detection, sausage deliveries, projector movie time, wake calls. Boomy-robot patrol integration ready.

## Stack

- Backend: FastMCP 3.4+ (Python, uv), served by uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:11142
- Frontend: React 18 + Vite + TailwindCSS (dark), Bun, served on 127.0.0.1:11143
- Storage: SQLite (local-first) - partners, products, orders
- Scheduler: APScheduler periodic jobs (patrol demo job)
- Desktop: optional Tauri 2.0 wrapper under native/

## Endpoints

- GET /api/health - server name, version, uptime, tool_count
- GET /api/v1/diagnostics - tool list + system info
- GET /api/skills - registered skills
- GET /api/tools - registered MCP tools
- GET /api/logs - in-memory log ring buffer
- GET /api/jobs - scheduler jobs (APScheduler)
- GET/PUT /api/dog/profile, GET/POST /api/dog/pics, GET/POST/DELETE /api/dog/tracks - onboarding data
- GET /api/dog/events - care event timeline (Vet page)
- GET/POST/DELETE /api/dog/vaccinations - vaccination schedule
- GET/POST/DELETE /api/dog/vet-visits - vet visit log
- GET/POST /api/partners, DELETE /api/partners/{id} - dog partners directory (tags; /api/members legacy alias)
- GET /api/products, POST /api/orders - webshop (SQLite)
- /mcp - MCP streamable HTTP endpoint (when enabled)
- /docs - FastAPI Swagger UI

## Start

pwsh -File start.ps1        # clears ports, starts backend + frontend, opens browser
uv run pytest tests/        # backend tests
npx --prefix webapp playwright test   # e2e tests

## Ports

Backend 11142, frontend 11143 (fleet registry 10700-11500).
